build_PartWiseDPEncoder: build a part-wise rigid deform positional encoder that projects points from world space to bone space
build_DisentangledDPEncoder: build a disentangled rigid deform positional encoder with learned part probability networks for NeRF
test_PartWiseDPEncoder_forward: test the PartWiseDPEncoder forward pass with point coordinates, covariance, and bone transforms
test_DisentangledDPEncoder_forward: test the DisentangledDPEncoder forward pass to get probability-weighted positional encodings and warp coordinates
review_DisentangledDPEncoder_nets: review the DisentangledDPEncoder learned probability networks that produce per-part softmax weights
